articles.title: Swimmer killed in shark attack in front of horrified beachgoers in Australia: "I could see a pool of blood" - CBS News
articles.description: It is the latest in a spate of shark attacks in the country and comes just days after a surfer was bitten in an attack in the same state.
articles.content:
A man was killed by a shark as he swam off a Western Australian city beach Friday while beachgoers watched in horror.
